# 3D Animation

3D animation: a short clip in the look of a 3D animated film, from a description or a picture in your MegaScenes library, with stylized characters, soft lighting and a cinematic camera.

## What it does
Describe the scene and the characters, or pick a picture from your MegaScenes library to start from. Claude tells you the price and makes the clip.

**How the files are made:** each clip is generated by a video model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Clips of a few seconds; ask for a vertical, square or wide frame.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install 3d-animation@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- 3D Animation talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/3d-animation/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each clip uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Clips take one to a few minutes: Claude checks on progress, and the clip plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps (a link in Claude Code).

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_animation_3d_models` | Models for 3D animations with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_animation_3d_cost` | Exact price of one 3D animation before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_animation_3d` | Starts one 3D animation in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_animation_3d` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A curious fox exploring a snowy forest, 3D animated look, 16:9"
- "A little dragon learning to fly over a village, vertical clip"
- "A robot watering plants on a sunny balcony, square"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the clip (the scene you describe and the picture you pick from your library, if any) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
